rows.43:2458:
"Yes, they're coming.
To kill someone in this room."
Then she looked at me and smiled sweetly.
...Someone's going to be killed?
Hold on a minute.
Please don't say things like that with a smile.
"Oh, Reiko!"
When she spotted Fukuzawa, she went over to her, and they clasped hands.
Fukuzawa had already called out to her. Had she really not noticed her until now?
"Wow, you're here too, Reiko.
Good for you, not getting killed."{p}
rows.43:3db0:
"That was booooring!"
The moment Motoki's story ended, Shindo was the one who yelled it.
Iwashita scoffed.
...True, compared with the stories I'd heard so far, it didn't really have much of a point, and I couldn't call it interesting by any means.
...Then again, compared with Kazama's story, it was plenty scary.
But what did that story have to do with me being saved?
Maybe I'd been taken in by one of Motoki's jokes.{p}
rows.43:4524:
What?
My heart skipped, and I found myself turning to look at Iwashita.
Iwashita was smiling, her head bowed.
...Had I just said something terrible?
If Shindo was right, I'd just said that Iwashita killed Kanda.
And I'd even called her someone who might do anything...
I wondered if I had offended Iwashita.
"...Well, who knows?
And Shindo, I don't think you should be so quick to believe rumors about people.{p}
rows.43:47e4:
...More to the point, your name was Fukuzawa, wasn't it?
I hear you secretly had feelings for Kanda.
And I heard that Kanda had recently started going out with a new girl.
Though, of course, that's nothing more than a rumor either.
I believe her name was Reiko Fukuzawa..."{p}
rows.43:48c8:
"What are you talking about?!"
Cutting Iwashita off, Fukuzawa slammed her hand down on the desk.
"Senior or not, there are things you just don't say!
Are you saying I killed Kanda?
Sure, I'll admit I liked him.
But why would I have to kill him?
When he died, I was the one who grieved the most!
I know the truth!
It was YOU!
You're the one who killed him!"{p}
rows.43:6954:
...Every one of them seemed like the killer.
...But there was no solid proof.
Besides, even if one of them was the killer, there was no way they'd admit to it.
But if this went on, we would all be killed.
...I couldn't possibly choose just one person.
In that instant, the name that came into my head was my own.
I steeled myself and took one step toward Kanda.{p}
